content: Ecitwîro
Nyakasane ashambâza Mûsa amubwîra, erhi:
Ogend’idôsa Bene Israheli obabwîre oku: Erhi hankabà owalonza okuyûkiriza eciragâne câge emwa Nyamuzinda omu kushiga ebyankafa omuntu, alagi oku agwâsirwe okujira:
Ecitwîro c’omulume w’emyâka makumi abirhi kuhika oku gali ndarhu, ali wa kugererwa oku sikêli makumi arhanu, co citwîro c’esikeli (ntûlo) y’aka-Nyamuzinda.
Akabà ali mukazi, anagererwa oku sikêli makumi asharhu.
Akabà murhabana: kurhenga oku myâka isharhu kuhika oku myâka makumi abirhi anagererwa oku sikêli makumi abirhi, omunyere anagererwa oku sikêli ikumi.
Kurhenga mwêzi muguma kuhika myâka irhanu, engombôlo y’omwânarhabana, olugero lwanabà lwa sikêli irhanu, n’okugombôla o­mwânanyere, olugero sikêli isharhu.
Kurhenga myâka makumi gali ndarhu kujà enyanya, olugero lwâwe lubè lwa sikêli ikumi n’irhanu oku mulume na sikêli ikumi oku mukazi.

Erhi olya wahânaga eciragâne ankabamukenyi, olya orhankahika oku lugero lw’okugombôla, kukwânîne alêrhere omudâhwa olya muntu ashîgaga ye wahûna olugero. Omudâhwa analujira kushimbana n’ebi o­lya wajiraga eciragâne ankabona.
Erhi nyakuhiga ankalagâna cintu cilebe mwa birya barherekêra Nyakasane, ngasi cîntu bankanarhûla Nyakasane cinahinduke cintu cimâna.
Barhankacihasha okucihingûla, barhankahingana ecibî oku cinjà erhi ecinjà oku cibî. Erhi bankahinganula ecintu oku cindi, byombi byombi erhi bikola bimâna.
Erhi ankabà cintu ciguma ca mwa birya bizira, birhankarherekêrwa Nyakasane, eco cintu banacimoleka omudâhwa.
Naye omudâhwa anahâna olugero lwâco, kushimbana n’oku ciri cinjà erhi cibî, kandi banakulikira olwo lugero luhânyirwe n’omudâhwa.
Ci erhi bankalonza okucigombôla, banayûshûla ecigabi ca karhanu oku lugero cikwânîne.
Erhi hankajira owalagâna enyumpa nterekêro emwa Nyakasane, omudâhwa anagend’ilola erhi eri nyinjà nîsi erhi mbî, kandi banashimba olugero lw’ecicîro omudâhwa asîmire.
Ci erhi olya wahânaga enyumpa yâge ciragâne ankalonza okuyigombôla, anayûshûla ecigabi ca karhanu oku Lugero omudâhwa ahûnaga, lyoki yankayôrha yâge.

Erhi hankajira owarherekêra Nyakasane ecihimbi c’ishwa lyâge yêne, wanarhôla olugero lwâwe omu kulola mburho nyinganaci wankarhwera muli lirya ishwa: sikêli makumi arhanu z’amarhale kuli nyamâha muguma w’emburho y’engano.
Erhi ankabà muli omu mwâka gw’okushagaluka, mwo ahânyire i­shwa lyâge nterekêro, anakulikira olugero lwâwe.

Ci kwônene erhi yankaba eri enyuma ly’omwâka gw’okushagaluka, lyo arherekîre ishwa lyâge, omudâhwa anatwa engulo omu kuganja emyâka ecisigîre, kuhika oku gundi mwâka gw’okucîshinga, na ntyo cirya citwîro canashubwakwo.
Erhi olya warherekêraga ishwa lyâge ankalonza okuligombôla, anayûshûla ecigabi ca karhanu oku citwîro, na ntyo ishwa lyanayôrha lyâge.
Erhi ankabà arhagômbwîri ishwa lyâge, abul’iliguliza owundi muntu, eryo ishwa lirhankacigombôlwa.
N’amango lyabà lirhacishwesirwi na cici, oku mwâka gw’okushagaluka, eryo ishwa lyanayôrha lirherekêre emwa Nyakasane, likola ishwa lyahânagwa ciragâne, lyanabà lya mudâhwa.
Erhi hankajira owarherekêra Nyakasane ishwa ahâbagwa cikinja, ci lirhali lyâge lwoshi,

omudâhwa anagend’ilola eryo ishwa, analijirire ecitwîro kushimbana n’amango gasigîre kuhika omu mwâka gw’okushagaluka. Oyo muntu anajuha olwo lusiku lwo na nnênè engulo batwa nka kantu karherekîrwe Nyakasane
Omu mwâka gw’okushagaluka eryo ishwa lyanashub’ibà ly’olya waliguzagya, ye olya wanali nnalyo lwoshi.
Ecicîro câwe coshi wakaz’icigerera oku sikêli y’aka-Nyamuzinda: ebà sikêli yankagererwa oku makumi abirhi.
Okugombôla emburhwa-lubere

Ci ntâye wankajira eciragâne c’ecintu mburhwa-lubere lw’omu bishwe­kwa byâge, bulya ebyo nka mburhwa-lubere, bikola biyôsire biri birherekêre Nyamuzinda, ebè nkâfu, cibè cibuzi byoshi biyôsire biri bya Nyakasane.
Erhi cankaba cintu cizira, banacigombôla oku ngulo obatwîrîre, n’okuyûshûla kwo ecigabi ca karhanu, n’erhi cankaba cirhagombwirwi, banaciguze oku ngulo wacitwiraga.
Okugombôla akantu erhi muntu warhûzirwe Nyamuzinda lwoshi

Ntâco omu bintu omuntu arhûzire Nyamuzinda lwoshi n’endahiro, abè muntu, cibè cintu, erhi ishwa by’omu buhiri bwâge ankahash’iderha mpu aguza erhi kugombôla, bulya ngasi kantu omuntu acìlahiriza oku akarhuzire Nyamuzinda n’endahiro bwenêne, kakola ka Nyakasane.
Ntà muntu warherekîrwe Nyakasane wankacigombôlwa: Banamuyîrhe erhi kwo.
Entûlo
Ngasi entûlo erhenga oku mburho y’okurhwêra ekuzimu, ebè y’oku malehe g’emirhi yoshi eri ya Nyakasane, buli buhirhi bwarherekîrwe Nyamuzinda.
Erhi hankajira owalonza okugombôla kantu kalebe k’oku ntûlo yâge, anayûshûlekwo ecigabi ca karhanu.
Oku biyêrekîre entûlo z’ebishwêkwa binene erhi binyinyi, ngasi hyoshi hihugwa n’akarhi k’omungere, ecigabi ca kali ikumi cakaz’irherekêrwa Nyamuzinda.

Barhalondôlaga mpu eci cintu co cinjà, nîsi erhi co cibî, barhanahîraga bacîshomya mpu bahinganula, n’erhi bakahinganula, byombi na byombi ebyahinganulagwa bikola bintu bimâna, birhankanahash’igombôlwa.
Gwo marhegeko Nyakasane ahâga Mûsa oku ntondo ya Sînayi Bene Israheli barhumire.
